top_signals.title: Senate Zip code changes would cause “irreparable harm,” postal chief says
top_signals.summary:
The U.S. Postal Service says congressional efforts to mandate dozens of zip code changes would hurt financially and cause delivery problems for residents.

The post Senate Zip code changes would cause “irreparable harm,” postal chief says appeared first on FreightWaves.
